candidate.answerReason: The successive discounts leave 50% and then 80% of the current price, giving 180 × 0.50 × 0.80 = 72 dollars.

methods.label: Apply the discounts in order
methods.explanation:
The Saturday discount applies to the sale price, so calculate that price first. A \(50\%\) reduction leaves \(50\%\) of the original price:
\[
180\times0.50=90.
\]
The additional \(20\%\) reduction leaves \(80\%\) of this \(\$90\) sale price:
\[
90\times0.80=72.
\]
The Saturday price is \(\$72\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Two successive percentage calculations use elementary discount reasoning appropriate for AMC 8.
